where: Before dawn, a riverboat lies moored beside a rickety pier on a quiet, misty fork of the Mordava. Lyra stands in its lamplit saloon before the crate, Reinhard beside her and Silas by the only door. Elves guard the deck. Poppen hides in the bushes at the treeline above the gangway, and Thalbern in a thicket on the bank below the stern. Neither hide can be seen from the other.
